headline: Dynamic Risk Assessment for Deep Excavations
subtitle: Geo-Engineering | EDGE Engineers

headline: The Challenge
bullets: Excavation risk is assessed once at design — then built in ground that keeps moving
Unplanned ground movement can halt a €40M project overnight
Static drawings give no warning as the dig advances

headline: The EDGE Solution
bullets: Fuse live sensor data (inclinometers, piezometers, strain gauges) with geotechnical models
Continuously recompute factor of safety as the dig progresses
48–72h early warning, audit-ready risk trail from first cut to handover

headline: Ready to know before the ground moves?
subtitle: ESA Incubatee | MaynoothWorks, Co. Kildare
